description: Harness for irl-subt-0i6.5. Stream live G2 PCM to wss://stt-rt.soniox.com stt-rt-v5 with diarization + language ID; record connect errors, first-token latency, token stream; test REST (models list / temporary key) for whitelist + CORS behavior.

comments.text: Hand-rolled WS/REST version works against the real server from desktop Chromium (invalid key -> readable 401 on REST => CORS OK for localhost origin; WS opens under COOP/COEP, server-error 401, clean close 1000). Superseded by SDK migration irl-subt-0i6.17.
